Compare commits of the last 12 complete months with the 12 months before

Source: R/github_commit_change.R
github_commit_change.Rd

Sums the commits column of github_commits over two windows of 12 calendar months each: the 12 months that end with end_month, and the 12 months before them. The scope can be narrowed to organisations and to public or private repositories. Months before an organisation was created count as zero commits.

Usage

github_commit_change(
  organisation = NULL,
  visibility = NULL,
  end_month = NULL,
  data = ghedata::github_commits
)

Arguments

organisation

Character vector of organisation logins as they appear in github_commits. NULL (the default) uses all organisations.

visibility

"public", "private" or NULL (the default) for both.

end_month

Last month of the current window, as a Date or a string such as "2026-10-01". NULL (the default) uses the last month in data.

data

A data frame with the columns of github_commits.

Value

A tibble with one row: the scope, the first and last month of both windows, commits_current, commits_previous and factor (current divided by previous, NA when the previous window has no commits).

Examples

# All organisations, public and private repositories
github_commit_change()
#> # A tibble: 1 × 9
#>   organisation visibility current_start current_end previous_start previous_end
#>   <chr>        <chr>      <date>        <date>      <date>         <date>      
#> 1 all          all        2025-11-01    2026-10-01  2024-11-01     2025-10-01  
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: commits_current <int>, commits_previous <int>,
#> #   factor <dbl>

# Private repositories of one organisation
github_commit_change(
  organisation = "Global-Health-Engineering",
  visibility = "private"
)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 9
#>   organisation  visibility current_start current_end previous_start previous_end
#>   <chr>         <chr>      <date>        <date>      <date>         <date>      
#> 1 Global-Healt… private    2025-11-01    2026-10-01  2024-11-01     2025-10-01  
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: commits_current <int>, commits_previous <int>,
#> #   factor <dbl>

# A fixed window, so the result does not change when the data is refreshed
github_commit_change(end_month = "2026-10-01")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 9
#>   organisation visibility current_start current_end previous_start previous_end
#>   <chr>        <chr>      <date>        <date>      <date>         <date>      
#> 1 all          all        2025-11-01    2026-10-01  2024-11-01     2025-10-01  
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: commits_current <int>, commits_previous <int>,
#> #   factor <dbl>
